name: Keyboard Tab traversal surfaces visible focus on interactive elements
description: When a visitor lands on the homepage and presses Tab repeatedly, focus advances through different interactive elements and each focused element displays a visible focus outline.

planSteps.description: Press the Tab key once to move focus to the first interactive element
Verify the currently focused element on the homepage displays a visible focus outline
Press the Tab key again to advance focus to the next interactive element
Verify focus moved to a different element than before and that the newly focused element also displays a visible focus outline
Press the Tab key three more times to advance focus through additional interactive elements
